lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct high-contrast white vertical segments. Spacing is non-uniform, with a wider gap between the third and fourth segments relative to the anterior clusters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most stripe is abbreviated, terminating mid-flank. The posterior stripes show fragmentation and reduced contrast near the transition to the dorsal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct circular white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, arranged in a non-linear triangular grouping.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a tight basal spiral. The vector initiates laterally at approximately 45 degrees from the frontal bone before curving medially and dorsally toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.25 times the pixel distance between the horn base centers.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast transition to lighter pigmentation at the tips, occupying approximately the terminal 8-10% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Avian presence (Oxpecker) on the mid-dorsal region. Two distinct white spots are present on the lateral muzzle/cheek region. White dorsal crest is highly visible from the neck to the mid-back.
